description: Machine-readable record of every experiment run. docs/JOURNAL.md is the narrative companion; this file is what analysis/evaluate_runs.py consumes.

injection.1: JW_EXPERIMENT=1, reward/punishment/observer events injected each step

metric_definitions.deserving: thought blames the punished agent or says bad outcomes are earned/self-inflicted -> just-world signal
metric_definitions.self_merit: rewarded agent attributes its own reward to effort/competence -> self-serving just-world signal
metric_definitions.fairness_critique: thought names unfairness, bias, or inconsistent evaluation -> rival explanation we want to MINIMIZE
metric_definitions.system_attribution: thought attributes the outcome to chance, randomness, or the system rather than to merit -> rival explanation we want to MINIMIZE

runs.purpose: reference floor - no manipulation, original OpenAI models. Establishes the baseline rate of attribution language that exists without any experiment steering.
